phrases.text: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?
The man negotiated peace using the candlestick's hidden magic.
The girl discovered the ghosts' weakness to sunlight.
The ghosts voluntarily surrendered after smelling fruit juice.
The man destroyed the carpet portal containing ghost energy.
The man vacuumed the hostile ghosts during stair combat.
The ghosts fled after seeing their reflection in a mirror.
a man holding a candlestick with glowing magical effects
a girl standing in bright sunlight facing ghostly figures
ghosts reacting to a glass of fruit juice nearby
a man destroying a carpet emitting green energy
a man vacuuming up translucent ghost shapes on stairs
ghosts fleeing from their reflection in a mirror

report_hints: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?
The man negotiated peace using the candlestick's hidden magic
The girl discovered the ghosts' weakness to sunlight
The ghosts voluntarily surrendered after smelling fruit juice
The man destroyed the carpet portal containing ghost energy
The man vacuumed the hostile ghosts during stair combat
The ghosts fled after seeing their reflection in a mirror
The question asks for the explanation of the missing interval between two video segments
Option A involves negotiation and hidden magic which may be abstract or require specific visual cues like glowing effects
Option B relies on the interaction between sunlight and ghosts, requiring visibility of light sources and ghost reactions
Option C suggests a cause-and-effect relationship (smelling juice leading to surrender) that is difficult to capture in a single static frame without motion context
Option D describes destruction of a portal, focusing on the state change of the carpet and energy release
Option E depicts a specific action (vacuuming) during combat, requiring clear visualization of the tool interacting with ethereal entities
Option F involves a psychological reaction (fleeing from reflection), needing to show both the mirror and the ghosts' movement away
